main_text.head: Cap. 16. De adjectivis parisyllabis utriusque declinationis: ubi de articulo.
main_text.p: Adjectiva parisyllaba, multa sunt utriusq; parisyllabæ communia. E masculino in os puro vel in εος, fœminino est in α: ex os non puro est in η: ut
ἅγιος, ἁγία, ἅγιον, sanctus, sancta, sanctum.
αἰσθηείς, αἰσθηεῖα, αἰσθηεῖν, floridus, florida, floridum.
καλὸς, καλὴ, καλὸν, bonus, bona, bonū.
Excipe οὐδὸος, οὐδὲν, οὐδὸν, octavus, octava, octavum.
χρύσεος, χρυσέη, χρύσεον, aureus, aurea, aureum.
χάλκεος, χαλκέη, χάλκεον, æneus, ænea, æneum.

page.notes: Greek accents and breathings are approximate given the faded scan; the Greek forms in the printed text may differ in detail. The tail of the page text is faded.
